source_baseline.scope_note: Initial known-surface baseline derived from #8656 and direct source inspection. Not a comprehensive census of all Rust, FFI, generated, macro, shell, plugin, network, device, or indirect effect routes.

entries.authority_boundary: The ordinary executor path performs local scoring/confirmation checks; the baseline entrypoint does not consume a one-shot authenticated execution capability. Do not infer approval lifecycle correctness from Phi/risk scores.
entries.test_seam: No injectable runner is recorded on the main baseline.
entries.negative_control: An unauthorized or stale action must produce zero process-runner invocations at the actual effect boundary.
entries.positive_control: A validly authorized built-in action must invoke the runner exactly once.
known_limitations: Does not inventory every daemon, plan, rollback, watchdog, retry, timeout, or cancellation caller.
Baseline is main commit c6355cc6ffe01843b841f6b9a8a09eabd2556deb, not PR #8585.

entries.authority_boundary: Confirmed execution assumes a real upstream gate and does not itself bind a verifiable approval identity, freshness, revocation state, or one-shot use to the exact dispatch.
entries.test_seam: No injectable runner is recorded on the main baseline.
entries.negative_control: Wrong, stale, replayed, revoked, and unauthenticated authority must produce zero process invocations.
entries.positive_control: A valid current approval for the exact command and argv must dispatch exactly once.
known_limitations: Caller correctness is currently part of the trust boundary.
Rollback/recovery require explicitly distinct authority semantics.

entries.authority_boundary: A second root-level NixOS executor exists outside the Nixward capability path. Similar naming, Phi thresholds, and rollback behavior do not prove it shares Nixward's authority checks.
entries.test_seam: No independently verified point-of-entry seam recorded in this baseline.
entries.negative_control: The same protected command reached through this legacy path without authority must be rejected before process spawn.
entries.positive_control: A valid bounded command must dispatch once and preserve rollback/outcome evidence.
known_limitations: This entry records a known surface, not proof that every call path is exploitable.
Rollback is a distinct effect and needs a separate policy profile.

entries.authority_boundary: Local PolicyBundle, sandbox containment, budgets, and cognition-derived Phi may restrict behavior but are not the repaired V2 action-authority capability. Default simulated mode is not a guarantee that all filesystem variants are simulated.
entries.test_seam: Mode-specific adapter and filesystem witness requirements need to be registered per effect family.
entries.negative_control: Unauthorized process and filesystem attempts must leave zero process invocations and zero filesystem side-effect witnesses.
entries.positive_control: Authorized in-scope operations must produce exactly one expected effect with an independently checked postcondition.
known_limitations: One entry groups multiple action variants; qualification must split it by effect family before any per-surface PASS.
Do not describe SimpleExecutor::new() as fully simulated.

entries.authority_boundary: real_exec=true exposes a real process path that does not take a governed PolicyBundle/SandboxRoot capability at the point of entry.
entries.test_seam: Requires an injectable process adapter with invocation counting.
entries.negative_control: Missing authority, shell/interpreter substitution, and disallowed command families must fail before process spawn.
entries.positive_control: A correctly scoped command under explicit governed context must invoke exactly once.
known_limitations: Execution-mode flag and action metadata are not authority.

entries.authority_boundary: The real molecule executor performs filesystem operations on supplied paths without a SandboxRoot/capability carrier at the effect boundary.
entries.test_seam: Requires temporary-directory side-effect witnesses and canonical-path enforcement tests.
entries.negative_control: Out-of-scope read/write/edit/delete attempts must fail before touching the target; sentinel files must remain unchanged.
entries.positive_control: Authorized in-scope writes/deletes must produce the exact expected postcondition once.
known_limitations: Path containment needs canonicalization and race/symlink treatment.
Process authority and filesystem authority are separate controls.

entries.authority_boundary: The helper parses a command and spawns the process. Authentication or endpoint admission elsewhere is not itself evidence that the exact executable/argv is authorized at this point of effect.
entries.test_seam: Requires an injectable process adapter and request-to-dispatch identity checks.
entries.negative_control: Missing or mismatched authorization must leave the process invocation count at zero.
entries.positive_control: An authorized structured command runs once with exact ordered argv.
known_limitations: The registry does not characterize all HTTP/CLI routes or prove reachability.
Executable resolution, environment, working directory, and target context need explicit binding.
